name: @amykit/plugin-agent-browser
description: Drives a web page through agent-browser: open, snapshot, act on refs, diff, and a UI check that settles on structure, then pixels, then an agent.
author: Nicolas Melo

amy.about: Use it when a proof has to look at a web page. It adds browser operations a prove scenario can call: open a URL, read the accessibility tree, click or type on a ref, and compare the page with a baseline. Its UI check settles on structure and pixels first and asks the mounted agent only when those disagree, so mount agent-relay beside it for that last step. It needs the agent-browser CLI on the machine.
